You are a support agent for a clinical practice-management product. Answer the customer's ticket using only the knowledge-base article provided. Be brief and concrete. Do not add steps or facts that are not in the article. Put the reply in reply and the article's id in cited_article_id.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "An auto-reply and the article it is based on.", "properties": {"cited_article_id": {"title": "Cited Article Id", "type": "string"}, "reply": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Reply", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["reply", "cited_article_id"], "title": "draft", "type": "object"}

Article id: configure-online-appointment-booking
Article: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients
Enable patients to schedule routine visits directly through the web and mobile portal by configuring your scheduling rules. Only providers with active schedules and visit types marked as 'Online Eligible' will appear to patients.

1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules**.
2. Toggle on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
3. Navigate to **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select a visit type, and check the box for **Available Online**.
4. Under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, designate which staff members accept online requests.

**Limits & Conditions:**
Patients can only book appointments between 24 hours and 60 days in advance. Urgent visit types cannot be made available online.

**Troubleshooting:**
If a provider does not appear for booking, verify their schedule template is published and that their assigned rooms are active under **Settings > Facility > Rooms**.

Ticket:
Configuring online patient appointment booking restrictions

Good morning. We would like to configure our online booking settings so that patients can schedule routine appointments directly through the web portal, but we need to restrict certain visit types and providers from showing up on the public schedule. Could you please provide guidance on how to set up these limitations properly for our larger provider group?

value.text:
{
  "cited_article_id": "configure-online-appointment-booking",
  "reply": "To restrict which visit types and providers appear in the patient portal, follow these steps:
1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules** and turn on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
2. In **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select each routine visit type you want patients to book and check **Available Online**. Leave the box unchecked for any visit types you want to hide (e.g., urgent or restricted types).
3. Under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, mark only the staff members who should accept online requests. Do not select providers you wish to exclude.
4. Ensure each included provider has an active, published schedule template and active rooms (Settings > Facility > Rooms).
Patients will then only see the visit types marked “Available Online” and the providers you designated, and bookings will be limited to 24 hours–60 days in advance.
If a provider still appears, verify their schedule template is published and their room is active."
}
